source.author: umask007 (base mesh by Clint Bellanger, face after MakeHuman)
source.note: Plan row 102 named the Quaternius Orc (Animated models, misc) on poly.pizza, now behind a Cloudflare challenge. Substituted with umask007's 'Ork' (orc barbarian) on OpenGameArt, a single Blender 2.68 .blend licensed CC-BY 3.0 only (checked on the page, Oct 2026); umask007's attribution instructions say the base mesh is based on Clint Bellanger's 'Base Human Models (low poly)' (OpenGameArt, CC-BY 3.0) and the face on a MakeHuman model. Opened only through the pipeline with auto-run off. The file ships six weapons on the rig; five of them (Axe, Bow, GreatSword, Hammer, Sword) are hidden from render in the file and are removed by the pipeline, so the one kept is the Hellebard (halberd), already bone-parented to hand_L, plus the ShoulderArmor on brust_L and the Schaerpe (shoulder strap). The skin has one packed 256 px baked texture (green skin with the eye whites); in Blender 4.2 its face-image link is lost, so the pipeline samples it for every material of the body mesh, which only over-splits the materials: every split maps back to its source material's role, and the white cluster of the skin is the eye whites. No colour script has a green, so the skin is painted noon's brick red (accent #c4452d over iris shade), which reads as non-human (the goblin is amber in indigo). Clips: kept 8 of 14 with keepActions. Dropped the four dualWield clips, spell and the one-handed attack: they were made for the hidden one-handed weapons and swing the halberd by one hand or push it through the body. Kept attack2h2 as attack (the full overhead chop), attack2h and attack2h3 under their names, die as death (ground clamp: the fall sinks up to 16 cm otherwise), flinch as hit, howl (raises the halberd overhead), walk and run (in place). There is no idle clip; the rest pose is a T-pose, so the views and the `stand` pose use flinch at 0 s, a neutral stance with the halberd upright. Known offset: the rest-pose bbox is measured in the T-pose with the halberd pointing forward, so after centring the body stands about 0.70 m behind the origin (hips at z = -0.70); move the root by +0.70 m in z to stand him on the spot.
source.changes: kept the halberd and dropped the hidden weapons; dropped six of fourteen clips; replaced the baked skin texture with flat colours; rescaled to 1.95 m and recentred; recoloured to the noon script; meshopt-compressed GLB
